features.job: Adapt a reusable workbench or article to its own available space.
features.fallback: A useful single-column flow; viewport media queries may improve wider fallback layouts.
features.constraints: Query an ancestor, not the element being styled. Containment changes intrinsic sizing; do not apply it to every element.
features.verify: Resize the component inside a wide viewport; verify long content, keyboard order and the no-container-query fallback.

features.job: Align comparable labels and values without duplicating arbitrary track widths.
features.fallback: Independent grid or ordinary definition-list flow retains the same relationships.
features.constraints: Do not use visual reordering to change reading order. A grid does not replace table semantics for tabular comparisons.
features.verify: Use unequal label/value lengths and text resizing; inspect alignment and source order.

features.job: Author coherent perceptual palette relationships with explicit semantic roles.
features.fallback: Define an explicit sRGB value before an optional modern color declaration.
features.constraints: Lightness is not WCAG luminance. Gamut mapping, alpha and painted backgrounds matter; current Hardlight contrast does not normalize this syntax.
features.verify: Inspect actual role/state pairs; unsupported color or paint remains unknown, never a pass by lightness.

features.feature: Color mixing in an explicit color space
features.job: Derive a controlled decorative or state surface from semantic tokens.
features.fallback: Use a named explicit color token with a tested foreground pair.
features.constraints: A mixed hover/disabled color is not automatically accessible. Check final paint in every applicable theme.
features.verify: Inspect default, selected, hover and focus paint. Preserve unknown results from unsupported syntax.

features.job: Improve the silhouette of short headings without editorial hard breaks.
features.fallback: Normal text wrapping with a readable maximum measure.
features.constraints: Line limits and algorithms differ across browsers. Use pretty selectively for prose; do not rebalance every data row.
features.verify: Test long headings, translations, fallback fonts and enlarged text; compare ordinary wrapping.

features.job: Show a temporary supplementary picker or explanation while keeping the page interactive.
features.fallback: Inline details/disclosure or an ordinary visible explanation.
features.constraints: Popover is non-modal. Use dialog.showModal() for a modal task; do not infer an accessible menu pattern from top-layer rendering.
features.verify: Exercise keyboard opening, Escape, focus return, light dismiss and the inline fallback in target browsers.

features.job: Show continuity during a deliberate view change without delaying the task.
features.fallback: Run the DOM update immediately; do not require animation promises for application state.
features.constraints: Skip motion when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce. Same-document support does not imply cross-document or every newer subfeature.
features.verify: Repeat activation and interrupt navigation; verify state, focus and history when transitions are unavailable or skipped.

features.job: Place supplementary UI beside its trigger when there is room.
features.fallback: Use an inline disclosure or deliberately positioned bounded panel.
features.constraints: Detect the exact placement/fallback properties used. Syntax support is not evidence of collision behavior or usable keyboard interaction.
features.verify: Test viewport edges, zoom, scrolling ancestors, long content, RTL and the unanchored fallback.

features.job: Align a carefully chosen display specimen with adjacent artwork.
features.fallback: Normal line boxes and explicit spacing.
features.constraints: A newer typography enhancement, not a reset for all text. Mixed scripts and fallback fonts have different metrics.
features.verify: Inspect accented capitals, descenders, alternate scripts and fallback fonts at multiple text sizes.

features.job: Optionally explain a disclosure changing size.
features.fallback: Immediate native disclosure; content is visible without interpolation.
features.constraints: Limited support; opt in narrowly. Never couple hidden state or essential content to animation completion.
features.verify: Test interruption, reduced motion and no-support behavior with focus inside the disclosure.

features.job: Explore conditional declarations in an isolated optional specimen.
features.fallback: Ordinary selectors, custom properties and @supports rules.
features.constraints: Experimental; not a prerequisite for production layout, navigation, readability or controls. Detection of one expression does not validate all branches.
features.verify: Exercise every branch and a browser without support; retain the equivalent ordinary declarations.
